_comment: Connector-specific edits a cli-printing-press reprint must NOT clobber. check_handfixes.py asserts every marker below is still present and fails CI if a reprint dropped one.

handfixes.summary: Separate userevents client + KNOWBE4_USER_EVENT_API_KEY for the User Event API (events group); a hand-authored second-key client
handfixes.why: KnowBe4 exposes two APIs behind one CLI: the Reporting API (KNOWBE4_API_KEY) and a separate User Event API on its own host with its own key (KNOWBE4_USER_EVENT_API_KEY). The `events` group (create/delete) talks to the User Event API via a dedicated hand-authored client package; the Reporting key cannot reach it. A reprint that drops the userevents package or its EnvKey breaks the events write surface.

handfixes.summary: `import` is a write but uses the MAIN Reporting key (flags.newClient), NOT the secondary User Event key; docs attribute keys per-write
handfixes.why: The natural-but-wrong mental model is 'the events sub-product is the write surface, so all writes use the events key.' FALSE: `import` is a bulk POST write that uses the MAIN Reporting key (import.go calls flags.newClient(), the primary client) - only `events create`/`events delete` use the secondary key. Two adversarial rounds were needed to get the docs right (README + SKILL.md both initially mis-attributed). The governance Write row must keep `import` attributed to the main key (no secondary-key note) while `events create` notes it needs KNOWBE4_USER_EVENT_API_KEY.

asserts.contains: `events create` (push a custom risk event; needs `KNOWBE4_USER_EVENT_API_KEY`), `import`

handfixes.summary: doctor probes a real GET endpoint with the real credential and refuses to dial a placeholder base_url, instead of calling any HTTP response 'reachable' and never checking the credential
handfixes.why: `doctor` is the command every SKILL, guide and docs page tells an operator to run to confirm the connector works, and it could not tell a working install from a broken one. It called any HTTP response to `GET /` "reachable" and rendered it green, so a base_url aimed at the vendor's web UI (where every API path 404s) and a token rejected with 401 on every call both produced an all-green report. On this connector family it also never probed the credential at all: it printed "present, not verified" and left the operator to guess. The mirror defect: a connector whose shipped base_url default is a placeholder dialled the placeholder host, and the DNS failure rendered as "FAIL API: unreachable" - telling a correctly-credentialled operator they were broken without naming the one variable that would fix it. Several placeholder hosts resolve through live wildcard DNS and answer real HTTP, so dialling one produced a confident green verdict against a stranger's server. Measured and gated by tools/maintainer/check_doctor_truth.py. See issue #282.

handfixes.summary: every operator credential this connector reads is declared on all three install channels: manifest.json (.mcpb), server.json (MCP Registry) and mcp-install.md (manual install)
handfixes.why: Issue #282 ('three live-verified connectors prompt for the wrong credentials'). A connector is installed through THREE independent channels that each carry their own copy of the credential list: manifest.json server.mcp_config.env (what the .mcpb bundle hands Claude Desktop, which has no shell profile, no config.toml and no export - so an undeclared variable is a variable nobody is ever asked for), server.json environmentVariables (the MCP Registry publish channel), and mcp-install.md's copy-paste JSON blocks plus its remote launch line (the manual path, which never touches the bundle at all). The fleet-wide audit found 60 of 65 connectors under-declaring 122 operator-facing variables in the manifest, 61 of 65 mcp-install.md pages omitting 125, and hudu's server.json missing the base URL its manifest marks required. For knowbe4 the manifest gained: KNOWBE4_BASE_URL, KNOWBE4_USER_EVENT_API_KEY. server.json gained: KNOWBE4_BASE_URL, KNOWBE4_USER_EVENT_API_KEY. mcp-install.md's env blocks gained: KNOWBE4_BASE_URL, KNOWBE4_USER_EVENT_API_KEY. manifest.json, server.json and mcp-install.md are ALL regenerated by /msp-skills-publish on an UPDATE or re-onboard, so without this ledger a regeneration silently drops every declaration and CI stays green (check_env_schema.py is wired --warn). The asserts below name the specific credentials, not a count, so dropping one and adding another cannot cancel out.
handfixes.spec_encode_followup: cli-printing-press should emit server.mcp_config.env, the matching user_config prompts, server.json environmentVariables and mcp-install.md's env blocks from ONE declaration of the connector's operator-facing environment, so the three channels cannot be generated out of step. Until then check_env_schema.py compares all three and this ledger pins them.
